bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 6 AM PST THIS MORNING THROUGH LATE TONIGHT... Combined seas 6 to 8 feet, building to 10 to 11 feet later this morning. Bar conditions moderate, becoming rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 1130 AM Wednesday, 1115 PM Wednesday, and 1215 PM Thursday.
